title: Prop 15.264 scheme Ext eq for μ_part; Ext[δ]=(p⁴−1)δ; ExtΠ=ΠExt; residual (i) OPEN

mupart_ext.theorem: On |κ|=1: Ext[μ_part]=(p⁴−1)μ_part+2φ, from Per κ=p⁴κ−6φ, Per φ=(2n+1)φ, and a,b of μ_part.  Coeff identity −6a+2nb−b(p⁴−1)=2 holds for all primes p≥5.

delta_eigen.theorem: On |κ|=1: Ext[δ]=(p⁴−1)δ for δ=μ−μ_part, since both μ and μ_part satisfy Ext[f]=(p⁴−1)f+2φ.

ext_Pi.theorem: Paley: Per Π = Π Per via U^T C U=−C and the permanent sign identity per(C[S,T])=χ_D(S)χ_D(T) per(C[π^{-1}S,π^{-1}T]).  Hence Ext Π = Π Ext on |κ|=1, and Ext preserves π-parity.

hinge.open: Scheme Ext eq for μ_part + Ext[δ]=(p⁴−1)δ + ExtΠ=ΠExt proved; π-odd ker of Ext−(p⁴−1)I on |κ|=1 still OPEN.

F3: μ_part satisfies Ext eq on |κ|=1 by Per eigenforms; Ext[δ]=(p⁴−1)δ; Ext commutes with Π.  π-odd kernel gap OPEN.  No predicate flip.
